notes.title: Patch v1.0.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers and Happy New Year!

Thank you for playing [i]Cramped Room of Death[/i] and sharing your valuable feedback with us!

With patch v1.0.1, we're rolling out the following fixes:

• Fixed the audio glitch that caused the pitch of sound effects to gradually decrease over time
• Fixed the bug that caused some sound effects to keep playing after a level is completed
• Fixed the issue with background music not changing when loading into the next world level directly from the previous world level
• Fixed the archer enemy's red line of sight appearing behind the character sprite
• Fixed a visual tile glitch in level 2-14 
• Fixed the issue with the world selection button background sprite not loading
• Fixed a bug that could cause the game to be stuck in level completion if the new level (new game plus) is played immediately after winning the game

We are also planning some "quality of life" improvements that will make it even more enjoyable to explore the dungeon. Watch the "News" section right here in the Steam community hub for more information as the next update gets closer to completion!

notes.title: Latest Update on Cramped Room of Death
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been one year since Cramped Room of Death free demo was released.

There's plenty of interesting addition to the game at this stage. The visual of the game has been completely refreshed for all of the levels. The levels is now grouped into five areas, with each area has their own theme. Additionally, each theme has their own core puzzle mechanic.

The puzzle is getting bigger for each level, it is almost two or three times longer to beat a level than what was presented in the demo level. The total number of levels also has been almost doubled from what was initially planned.
